data.name: StorePruneFormat
data.value: Removed {0} Assessments and {3} invocation directories; kept {4} unowned directories ({5} bytes) in {6}; store: {1} to {2} bytes.
data.comment: Counts of removed Assessments and invocation directories, kept unowned directories and their bytes and parent path; store size before and after.

data.name: StorePruneSizeIncomplete
data.value: The unowned directory size is incomplete.
data.comment: Added when the size of retained unowned directories could not be fully measured.

data.name: StorePruneIncomplete
data.value: Reclamation is incomplete while readers are active.
data.comment: Added when active readers prevent complete store reclamation.

data.name: StorePruneBudgetFormat
data.value: Store budget {0} bytes, {1} bytes in use{2}.
data.comment: Store byte budget and bytes in use; the third value is the over-budget note or empty.

data.name: StorePruneOverBudget
data.comment: Added when the store still holds more than its budget.

data.name: StorePruneKeptAssessments
data.comment: Counts of kept Assessments by reason code, such as openProposal=3, report=2.

data.name: StorePruneKeptRuns
data.comment: Counts of kept invocation directories by reason code.

data.name: StorePruneKeptUserData
data.value: Kept per-user data entries by reason: {0}.
data.comment: Counts of kept runs, sources and Baselines in the per-user data folder by reason code.

data.name: StorePruneUserDataFormat
data.value: Per-user data: removed {0} sources and {1} Baselines ({2} bytes); {3} bytes kept.
data.comment: Removed source copies and Baselines, bytes freed and bytes kept in the per-user data folder.
